meta.title: Source inbox
meta.description: One workbench that archives your own account materials into a local knowledge base: 27 platforms with one-click official entry links, 84 steps of guidance for what to do after the login page, paste-and-save credential boxes, and a plugin-owned controlled browser that reads your own logged-in pages. Link-to-Markdown, WeRead highlight export, Cubox sync and IMAP mail all ship inside the plugin, so the panel never asks you to install a third-party package. Text is stored on disk; large media is kept as a reference with a text shadow. Includes an import wizard, unified schema, dual-track archiving, a sidebar workbench, and 17 agent tools.
